name: Independent on Sunday cryptic crossword No 1,795

entries.clue: Crook damaged most of table and rug in vehicle (3-7)

indicatorNotes.damaged: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so its letters are knocked out of order
indicatorNotes.most of: most, not all, so the last letter of the table goes
indicatorNotes.in: the jumbled letters ride inside the vehicle, as passengers do

blocks.note: CAR, the vehicle, opens around the jumble; CA before it
TABL(e) plus RUG, rearranged
the closing R of CAR

annotation.surface: Someone vandalises the furniture and the rug in a car.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface paints a vandal, which is close to a crook, so the definition hides by blending in.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym at one remove: a cat burglar is a particular kind of thief, one who climbs in through upstairs windows, and every thief is a crook.

entries.clue: Vessels moving up Southern Point (4)

indicatorNotes.moving up: in a down answer, up means earlier, so the S climbs one place in the word

blocks.note: cups are drinking vessels
S = Southern: names the letter that moves

annotation.surface: Ships heading north past a southern headland.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Vessels' and 'Point' paint ships rounding a headland; the vessels are crockery, and only one letter shifts.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym from geometry and astronomy: a cusp is the sharp point where two curves meet, as at the horns of a crescent moon.

entries.clue: Cross about tirade over large adult arthropod (9)

indicatorNotes.about: around, so the cross wraps itself about the tirade
indicatorNotes.over: in a down answer, what is over sits above, so the cross-and-tirade comes before the rest

blocks.note: a tau cross is T-shaped, named for the Greek letter
rant = tirade, placed inside TA_U
L = large, as on clothing labels
A = adult, an old film certificate

annotation.surface: Someone angrily rants about a huge creepy-crawly.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Large adult arthropod' reads as one description of the spider; only the last word defines, and 'large adult' supplies L and A.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by class: a tarantula is a big hairy spider, and spiders belong to the arthropods, the jointed-legged animals.

entries.clue: Taste cut meat maid oddly cut (5)

indicatorNotes.oddly cut: the odd-numbered letters are cut away, leaving the even ones

blocks.note: keep the 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th and 10th letters of these three words

annotation.walkthrough: The first 'cut' looks like a verb about the meat; it is only fodder, and the final 'cut' does the work.
annotation.definitionFit: A Japanese loanword: umami is the savoury fifth basic taste alongside sweet, sour, salty and bitter, so the definition is its category.

entries.clue: Cop recalled self-satisfied male eating donut (7)

indicatorNotes.recalled: called back, and going back means reading backwards
indicatorNotes.eating: what eats takes the food inside, so the male swallows the O

blocks.note: smug = self-satisfied
he = a male
a donut is ring-shaped, like the letter O

annotation.surface: A smug policeman caught eating a doughnut.
annotation.walkthrough: The cop-and-donut surface is the cliché itself, so the answer sits inside its own picture.
annotation.definitionFit: American slang: a gumshoe is a detective, from the soft rubber soles that let one follow quietly, so a cop in the loose sense.

entries.clue: Contractor perhaps also on leave (7)

blocks.note: an ab (abdominal muscle) contracts; 'perhaps' marks it as one example
and = also
used as is

annotation.surface: A builder is also away on holiday.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Contractor' suggests a builder; here it is a muscle that contracts. 'Leave' reads as a noun, time off, but is the verb.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym once the part of speech flips: leave as a verb, to go away from and desert, which is what abandon means.

entries.clue: Regressive way of paying someone, one crossing a line (4)

indicatorNotes.Regressive: regressing is going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse

blocks.note: BACS is the UK's automated bank payment system, used for wages

annotation.surface: A backward way of paying staff.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Regressive' sounds like tax policy, which suits paying people; it is only the turnaround.
annotation.definitionFit: Industrial slang: a scab is a worker who crosses a picket line to keep working during a strike, so the line is a picket line.

entries.clue: Musical cabinets not keeping time (5)

indicatorNotes.not keeping: the cabinets do not keep hold of the time, so the T is dropped

blocks.note: chests = cabinets, as in a chest of drawers
T = time, removed

annotation.walkthrough: 'Musical' looks like an adjective describing the cabinets; it is the noun.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: Chess is a 1980s stage musical by Tim Rice and the ABBA songwriters, one musical among many.

entries.clue: Painter of note on US phone in Program 1 (10)

indicatorNotes.in: the note and phone sit inside the program and the 1, as a file sits in a folder

ti, the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
Americans say cell for a mobile phone
Roman numeral one

annotation.walkthrough: 'Of note' reads as 'famous'; split it, and 'note' is its own piece.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by class: Sandro Botticelli, the Florentine who painted The Birth of Venus, is one painter among many.

entries.clue: A long period carrying fruit and feathers (8)

'for ages' = for a long period

annotation.walkthrough: 'A long period' is one piece, not A plus something; 'ages' is a single idiom for a long time.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym with a number twist: plumage is a bird's whole coat of feathers, and plumages are several such coats.

entries.clue: First 365 days hosted by South American country (5)

first = one = I

annotation.walkthrough: 'South American country' looks like one phrase; the definition is only 'country', and it is in the Middle East.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by class: Syria is one country among many, on the eastern Mediterranean, nowhere near the South America the surface points at.

entries.clue: Counterfeit sale items most spotted (9)

indicatorNotes.Counterfeit: a counterfeit is a false copy, so the letters are rearranged into something that is not what it seems

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 9 letters

annotation.surface: Fake goods at a sale are the ones most often noticed.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Spotted' reads as 'noticed'; the definition means covered in spots.
annotation.definitionFit: A literal sense: measly first meant blotched with the spots of measles, so the measliest thing is the most spotted, not the stingiest.

entries.clue: One child nursed by Nurse Ruby made better (8)

indicatorNotes.nursed by: a nurse cradles a baby in the arms, so RED holds the pair inside it

blocks.note: EN = Enrolled Nurse
ruby is a shade of red; RED opens around the pair
Roman numeral one
CH = child, as in the abbreviation

annotation.surface: A nurse called Ruby looks after a child and makes it better.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Nurse Ruby' reads as a name; it is two pieces, and only the colour does the nursing.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to enrich something is to improve its quality, as soil or a diet is enriched.

entries.clue: Language degrees prior to ChatGPT? (5)

indicatorNotes.prior to: prior means earlier, so the degrees come first in the answer

blocks.note: MAs, Master of Arts degrees
ChatGPT is an example of AI; the question mark flags the example

annotation.walkthrough: The surface is about technology and education; the answer is an East African language.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by class: Masai (Maa) is the tongue of the Maasai people of Kenya and Tanzania, one language among many.

entries.clue: New pater she finds tiresome at first? (10)

annotation.definition: New pater she finds tiresome at first?

indicatorNotes.New: something made new is made over, so the letters are reworked into a new order
indicatorNotes.at first: at the first of each word, so take the initial letters of finds and tiresome

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 8 letters
first letters of finds and tiresome, joining the fodder

annotation.surface: A girl finds her mother's new husband a pain.
annotation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too, and the question mark admits it: pater is Latin for father.
annotation.definitionFit: An &lit: read straight, the clue describes a new father whom a stepdaughter may resent at the start, which is the stereotype of a stepfather.

entries.clue: Shelf further back hides confection (7)

indicatorNotes.back: going back means reading from right to left
indicatorNotes.hides: what hides something keeps it inside, so the letters are concealed in the words

blocks.note: the run starts at the E of shelf and ends at the T of further

annotation.walkthrough: 'Further back' looks like a place on the shelf; 'further' is fodder and 'back' is the instruction.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by class: a chocolate truffle is a soft ganache ball, one kind of confection or sweet.

entries.clue: Bobby still with fellow also going north (8)

indicatorNotes.going north: north is up the page, so in a down answer the word is read upwards

blocks.note: flat, as in still (not fizzy) water
F = fellow
too = also

annotation.walkthrough: 'Still' reads as an adverb but is the adjective, of drinks without bubbles.
annotation.definitionFit: Slang for slang: a bobby is a British police officer, and flatfoot is older American slang for a patrolling cop.

entries.clue: Garment extremely ineffective on naked men (7)

indicatorNotes.extremely: at the extremes, so only the first and last letters

blocks.note: KNIGHTS are chessmen; stripped, they lose their first and last letters
first and last letters of ineffective

annotation.surface: An item of clothing does little to cover naked men.
annotation.walkthrough: Men are chess pieces here, so a solver hunting for a word for 'men' should think of the board.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by class: a nightie is a nightdress, one garment among many, and apt for the naked men of the surface.

entries.clue: Ur art emir reconstructed for 2's home? (9)

indicatorNotes.reconstructed: rebuilt from the same materials in a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 9 letters

annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: a terrarium is a glass enclosure for small land animals, and a pet tarantula typically lives in one.

entries.clue: Public notice character east of mountain rotated (7)

a card is an eccentric, amusing person

entries.clue: Flower best put below daughter's computer (7)

entries.clue: Setter accompanying pianist on European mix (7)

Lang Lang, the Chinese concert pianist
E = European
